title: Monotone maximum partial-twuality widths of vf-safe delta-matroids
summary: For a delta-matroid, the maximum twist width theorem states that the maximum width over all twists can be reached along a non-decreasing sequence of intermediate twist widths. In this paper we study analogous monotone maximum width sequences for partial twualities generated by twist and loop complementation. We prove that, for each non-twist partial-twuality operation on a vf-safe delta-matroid, there exists a subset attaining the corresponding maximum partial-twuality width whose elements can be ordered so that the successive intermediate widths are non-decreasing.
